source_title: Historical increase in agricultural machinery weights enhanced soil stress levels and adversely affected soil functioning
source_notes: Mechanistic and synthesis source for compaction effects on root accessibility, infiltration, hydraulic conductivity/storage, yield-reference caveats and scale-up uncertainty.

source_title: The total costs of soil degradation in England and Wales
source_notes: Economic/ecosystem-services framework; useful for contextual counterfactuals, soilscape aggregation and on-site/off-site/private/external distinctions. UK coefficients are not transferred directly to the Netherlands.

source_title: Effecten van verbetering bodemkwaliteit op waterhuishouding en waterkwaliteit
source_notes: Dutch WUR/STOWA synthesis and modelling source for profile geometry, hourly forcing, SWAP response sensitivity and local runoff/evapotranspiration examples. Numerical results are case-specific.

source_title: Kosten en baten van bodembeheer; Maatregelen tegen winderosie veenafbraak en ondergrondverdichting
source_notes: Exploratory Dutch economic/context study. Historical hectare-cost estimates and external-effect discussion are context/benchmarks, not current unit costs.

source_title: Compaction induced losses in soil services in Europe under future climate
source_notes: European future-climate modelling framework covering yield, nitrogen, carbon and runoff. Useful for multi-service/scenario framing; not a current Netherlands parameter source.

source_title: Regionale kartering bodemverdichting in de provincie Flevoland
source_notes: Wageningen Environmental Research Rapport 3382. Documents the 2020-2021 Flevoland field campaign using dry bulk density and penetration resistance and explicitly concludes that the available measurements/covariates did not yield a usable regional compaction map.

source_title: Flevo - land in beweging
source_notes: Official NWO-SIA project record for RAAK.PRO02.021. States that more than 300 point measurements and a valuable province-wide compaction dataset were collected; does not itself expose a raw georeferenced measurement table.

source_title: Waterschap Zuiderzeeland zzl_Drainage FeatureServer
source_notes: Owner-hosted parcel-drainage inventory route reviewed 2026-09-16. Layer data last edit 2021-06-27; OT.02 records expose spacing/date/depth fields but those fields are incomplete for source-model parameterization.

source_title: Waterschap Zuiderzeeland Legger watersysteem 2024 Noordoostpolder owner service
source_notes: Owner-maintained Noordoostpolder water-system topology service; data last edit 2025-08-27. Public notice reviewed is the second design/draft legger consultation, so this project does not independently assert final legal status for every feature.

source_title: Watererfgoed Noordoostpolder: het verhaal
source_notes: Owner-hosted historical narrative on the Noordoostpolder water system and systematic parcel drainage. Historical context only, not a current drainage asset register.

source_title: KNMI Uurgegevens van het weer in Nederland
source_notes: Official KNMI hourly climatology service. Historical station 273 Marknesse observations were retrieved reproducibly on 2026-09-16 for the October 1998 Tollebeek event; raw response SHA-256 71f2b135769bfed476bbc9ee55282d7e5e9766e2eaf444aa1b8694d382d08dde.

source_title: BRO / PDOK Grondwatermonitoring in samenhang and GLD public service
source_notes: Public BRO/PDOK route used 2026-09-16 to discover historical GLD series, monitoring wells/tubes and source-native compact GLD observations around admitted OT.02. Historical IMBRO/A series may carry observation status onbekend; such records are not silently promoted to assessed measurements.

source_title: Peilbesluit Tollebeek 2006
source_notes: Official near-period owner peilbesluit for the separate Tollebeek underbemalingen. It re-establishes the existing 1992 peilregime without peil changes and documents targets, pump capacities and water-system relations in 2006; it is not an event telemetry source for October 1998.

source_title: Waterschap Zuiderzeeland waterinformatie request route
source_notes: Owner route for requesting water information including maps and measurement results when online sources are insufficient. Qualified as an acquisition route only; it does not itself provide the requested 1998 telemetry.

source_title: Landelijk Grondgebruiksbestand LGN3
source_notes: Wageningen Environmental Research historical land-use dataset. LGN3 is 25 m; agricultural classification in Flevoland uses 1995 imagery. Qualified as pre-event spatial land-use/crop context, not a 1998 crop observation.

source_title: Landelijk Grondgebruiksbestand LGN4
source_notes: Wageningen Environmental Research historical land-use dataset based on 1999/2000 satellite imagery. Qualified as post-event land-use/crop context, not a 1998 crop observation.

source_title: Land use mapping and monitoring in the Netherlands
source_notes: LGN methodology source explaining that crop-type changes can reflect crop rotation and should not be treated as stable land-use change. Used as a temporal-transfer guardrail.

source_title: PDOK / RVO Gewaspercelen historical archive route
source_notes: Public parcel/crop service derived from RVO BRP. Historical public annual datasets are documented for 2009-2022; therefore this public route does not directly provide 1998 parcel/crop identity.

source_title: SWAP5 Status-A current-canonical authority chain
source_notes: Immutable reviewed snapshot of SWAP5 current Status-A documentation. Distinguishes scientific production baseline 50346642..., Status-A acceptance authority 992a5c65..., and later canonical governance head 80c6faaa.... Used to qualify execution authority only, not to fill missing Tollebeek run inputs.

source_title: SWAP version 4: theory description and user manual
source_notes: Primary SWAP theory/input authority used here to define the hydraulic representation consumed by the model; it does not provide Tollebeek-specific hydraulic values.

source_title: Waterretentie- en doorlatendheidskarakteristieken van boven- en ondergronden in Nederland: Staringreeks update 2018
source_notes: Dutch modal soil-hydraulic reference framework. Qualified as profile/method context; not automatically CURRENT or REFERENCE compaction-state hydraulics.

source_title: Bodemverdichting in Vlaanderen: Gevolgen van bodemverdichting op het watertransport door een bodem
source_notes: WUR compaction/hydraulics study with measured properties, bulk-density-responsive pedotransfer functions and SWAP application; method precedent, not Tollebeek calibration.

source_title: De invloed van bodemverdichting op de plantontwikkeling: BoVer eindrapport
source_notes: WUR laboratory/column/field compaction experiments including treatment-specific hydraulic properties and SWAP simulations. Method evidence only for this project.

source_title: Using Pedotransfer Functions to Estimate the van Genuchten-Mualem Soil Hydraulic Properties: A Review
source_notes: Review of VGM pedotransfer functions, predictor sets, performance and need for structural/time-dependent information.

source_title: Effects of compaction on soil hydraulic properties, penetration resistance and water flow patterns at the soil profile scale
source_notes: Field experiment demonstrating state-dependent bulk density, structural pore space, saturated conductivity and flow effects; supports the no-BD-only guardrail.

source_title: Impact of traffic-induced compaction of sandy soils on the yield of silage maize in The Netherlands
source_notes: Original Dutch four-location sandy-soil maize study. Bibliography/DOI and abstract-level quantitative results independently recovered; full article text was not ingested in this migration. Treatment is axle load, not CC-NL severity.

source_title: De invloed van berijding op de fysische bodemconditie van zandgrond en de gevolgen daarvan voor de grasproduktie
source_notes: Original IMAG-DLO report 94-5 on Oostwaardhoeve grassland compaction. Direct report metadata and result text recovered. Response is non-monotonic with highest yield at the moderate 4.5 t treatment; treatment load is not a generic field-compaction class.

source_title: Effect bodemverdichting op opbrengst en stikstofopname Engels raaigras op zandgrond
source_notes: Original PR report 152 for Cranendonck sandy grassland. Source identity is recovered; key sign-changing yield interpretation is corroborated by WER 2811 and later WUR reports. Full report extraction remains incomplete.
